      try {\n            String body = readBody(exchange);\n            Map<String, Object> req = parseJsonObject(body);\n            List<Object> partyList = (List<Object>) req.get(\"party\");\n            List<Object> monstersList = (List<Object>) req.get(\"monsters\");\n            if (partyList == null || monstersList == null) throw new RuntimeException(\"Missing fields\");\n\n            int = 0, medium = 0, hard = 0, deadly = 0;\n            for (Object memberObj : partyList) {\n                Map<String, Object> member = (Map<String, Object>) memberObj;\n                int level =              easy += thresholds[0];\n                medium += thresholds[1];\n                hard += thresholds[2];\n                deadly += thresholds[3];\n            }\n\n            String difficulty;\n            if (adjustedXp >= deadly) difficulty = \"deadly\";\n            else if (adjustedXp >= hard) difficulty = \"hard\";\n            else if (adjustedXp >= medium) difficulty =     thresholds.put(\"easy\", easy);\n            thresholds.put(\"medium\", medium);\n            thresholds.put(\"hard\", hard);\n            thresholds.put(\"deadly\", deadly);\n\n          res.put(\"adjusted_xp\", adjustedXp);\n            res.put(\"difficulty\", difficulty);\n            res.put(\"thresholds\", thresholds);\n            sendResponse(exchange, 200, @SuppressWarnings(\"unchecked\")\n    private static Object parseJson(String s) {\n        return new JsonParser(s).parse();\n    }\n\n    private static String toJson(Object value) {\n        if sendResponse(exchange, 405, \"{\\\"error\\\":\\\"Method not allowed\\\"}\");\n            return;\n        }\n        try {\n            String body = readBody(exchange);\n            Map<String, Object> req = parseJsonObject(body);\n            String expression = (String) req.get(\"expression\");\n            if (expression == null) throw new RuntimeException(\"Missing expression\");\n            Matcher matcher = DICE_PATTERN.matcher(expression.trim());\n            if (!matcher.matches()) throw new RuntimeException(\"Invalid expression\");\n            int count = Integer.parseInt(matcher.group(1));\n            int sides = Integer.parseInt(matcher.group(2));\n            if (count <= 0 || sides <= 0) throw new RuntimeException(\"Count and sides must be positive\");\n            String modifierPart = matcher.group(3);\n            int modifier = modifierPart == null ? 0 : Integer.parseInt(modifierPart);\n\n            Map<String, Object> res = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n            res.put(\"dice_count\", count);\n            res.put(\"sides\", sides);\n            res.put(\"modifier\", modifier);\n            res.put(\"min\", count + modifier);\n            res.put(\"max\", count * sides + modifier);\n            res.put(\"average\", count * (sides + 1) / 2.0 + modifier);\n            sendResponse(exchange, 200, toJson(res));\n        } catch (Exception e) {\n            sendResponse(exchange, 400, \"{\\\"error\\\":\\\"Invalid request\\\"}\");\n        }\n    }\n\n    private static void handleAbilityCheck(HttpExchange exchange) throws IOException {\n        if (!\"POST\".equals(exchange.getRequestMethod())) {\n            sendResponse(exchange, 405, \"{\\\"error\\\":\\\"Method not allowed\\\"}\");\n            return;\n        }\n        try {\n            String body = readBody(exchange);\n            Map<String, Object> req = parseJsonObject(body);\n            int roll = toInt(req.get(\"roll\"));\n            int modifier = res.put(\"total\", total);\n            res.put(\"success\", total >= dc);\n            res.put(\"margin\", total - dc);\n            sendResponse(exchange, 200, toJson(res));\n        } catch IOException {\n        if (!\"POST\".equals(exchange.getRequestMethod())) {\n            sendResponse(exchange, 405, \"{\\\"error\\\":\\\"Method not allowed\\\"}\");\n            return;\n        }\n        try {\n            String body = readBody(exchange);\n            Map<String, Object> req = parseJsonObject(body);\n            List<Object> partyList = (List<Object>) req.get(\"party\");\n            List<Object> monstersList = (List<Object>) req.get(\"monsters\");\n            if (partyList == null || monstersList == null) throw new RuntimeException(\"Missing fields\");\n\n            int baseXp = 0;\n            int monsterCount = 0;\n            for (Object monsterObj : monstersList) {\n                Map<String, Object> monster = (Map<String, Object>) monsterObj;\n                String cr = (String) monster.get(\"cr\");\n                int count = toInt(monster.get(\"count\"));\n                Integer xp = CR_XP.get(cr);\n                if (xp == null) throw new RuntimeException(\"Unsupported CR: \" + cr);\n                baseXp += xp * count;\n                monsterCount += count;\n            }\n\n            double multiplier;\n            if (monsterCount == 1) multiplier = 1;\n            else if (monsterCount == 2) multiplier = 1.5;\n            else if (monsterCount <= 6) multiplier = 2;\n            else if (monsterCount <= 10) multiplier = 2.5;\n            else if (monsterCount <= 14) multiplier = 3;\n            else multiplier = 4;\n\n            long adjustedXp = Math.round(baseXp * multiplier);\n\n            int easy = 0, medium = 0, hard = 0, deadly = 0;\n            for (Object memberObj : partyList) {\n                Map<String, Object> member = (Map<String, Object>) memberObj;\n                int level = toInt(member.get(\"level\"));\n                int[] thresholds = LEVEL_THRESHOLDS.get(level);\n                if (thresholds == null) throw new RuntimeException(\"Unsupported level: \" + level);\n                easy += thresholds[0];\n                medium += thresholds[1];\n                hard += thresholds[2];\n                deadly += thresholds[3];\n            }\n\n            String difficulty;\n            if (adjustedXp >= deadly) difficulty = \"deadly\";\n            else if (adjustedXp >= hard) difficulty = \"hard\";\n            else if (adjustedXp >= medium) difficulty = \"medium\";\n            else if (adjustedXp >= easy) difficulty = \"easy\";\n            else difficulty = \"trivial\";\n\n            Map<String, Object> thresholds = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n            thresholds.put(\"easy\", easy);\n            thresholds.put(\"medium\", medium);\n            thresholds.put(\"hard\", hard);\n            thresholds.put(\"deadly\", deadly);\n\n            Map<String, Object> res = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n            res.put(\"base_xp\", baseXp);\n            res.put(\"monster_count\", monsterCount);\n            res.put(\"multiplier\", multiplier);\n            res.put(\"adjusted_xp\", adjustedXp);\n            res.put(\"difficulty\", difficulty);\n            res.put(\"thresholds\", thresholds);\n            sendResponse(exchange, 200, toJson(res));\n        } catch (Exception e) {\n            sendResponse(exchange, 400, \"{\\\"error\\\":\\\"Invalid request\\\"}\");\n        }\n    }\n\n    private static void handleInitiative(HttpExchange exchange) throws IOException {\n        if (!\"POST\".equals(exchange.getRequestMethod())) {\n            sendResponse(exchange, 405, \"{\\\"error\\\":\\\"Method not allowed\\\"}\");\n            return;\n        }\n        try {\n            String body = readBody(exchange);\n            Map<String, Object> req = parseJsonObject(body);\n            List<Object> combatantsList = (List<Object>) req.get(\"combatants\");\n            if (combatantsList == null) throw new RuntimeException(\"Missing combatants\");\n\n            List<Map<String, Object>> name = (String) combatant.get(\"name\");\n                int dex = toInt(combatant.get(\"dex\"));\n                int roll = toInt(combatant.get(\"roll\"));\n                int score = roll + dex;\n                Map<String, Object> out = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n                out.put(\"name\", name);\n                out.put(\"score\", score);\n                out.put(\"_dex\", dex);\n                combatants.add(out);\n            }\n\n            combatants.sort((a, b) -> {\n                int scoreA = (Integer) a.get(\"score\");\n                int scoreB = (Integer) b.get(\"score\");\n                if (scoreB != scoreA) return scoreB - scoreA;\n                int dexA = (Integer) a.get(\"_dex\");\n                int dexB = (Integer) b.get(\"_dex\");\n                if (dexB != dexA) return dexB - dexA;\n                String nameA = (String) a.get(\"name\");\n                String nameB = (String) b.get(\"name\");\n                return nameA.compareTo(nameB);\n            });\n\n            List<Map<String, Object>> order = new ArrayList<>();\n            for (Map<String, Object> combatant : combatants) {\n                Map<String, Object> out = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n                out.put(\"name\", combatant.get(\"name\"));\n                out.put(\"score\", combatant.get(\"score\"));\n                order.add(out);\n            }\n\n            Map<String, Object> res = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n            res.put(\"order\", order);\n            sendResponse(exchange, 200, toJson(res));\n        }      }\n            }\n        }\n\n        CombatSession getCombatSession(String id) {\n            synchronized (lock) {\n                List<Map<String, Object>> sessionRows = query(\"SELECT id, sendResponse(exchange, 405, \"{\\\"error\\\":\\\"Method not allowed\\\"}\");\n            return;\n        }\n        try {\n            String body = readBody(exchange);\n            Map<String, Object> req = parseJsonObject(body);\n            String expression = (String) req.get(\"expression\");\n            if (expression == null) throw new RuntimeException(\"Missing expression\");\n            Matcher matcher = DICE_PATTERN.matcher(expression.trim());\n            if (!matcher.matches()) throw new RuntimeException(\"Invalid expression\");\n            int count = Integer.parseInt(matcher.group(1));\n            int sides = Integer.parseInt(matcher.group(2));\n            if (count <= 0 || sides <= 0) throw new RuntimeException(\"Count and sides must be positive\");\n            String modifierPart = matcher.group(3);\n            int modifier = modifierPart == null ? 0 : Integer.parseInt(modifierPart);\n\n            Map<String, Object> res = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n            res.put(\"dice_count\", count);\n            res.put(\"sides\", sides);\n            res.put(\"modifier\", modifier);\n            res.put(\"min\", count + modifier);\n            res.put(\"max\", count * sides + modifier);\n            res.put(\"average\", count * (sides + 1) / 2.0 + modifier);\n            sendResponse(exchange, 200, toJson(res));\n        } catch (Exception e) {\n            sendResponse(exchange, 400, \"{\\\"error\\\":\\\"Invalid request\\\"}\");\n        }\n    }\n\n    private static void handleAbilityCheck(HttpExchange exchange) throws IOException {\n        if (!\"POST\".equals(exchange.getRequestMethod())) {\n            sendResponse(exchange, 405, \"{\\\"error\\\":\\\"Method not allowed\\\"}\");\n            return;\n        }\n        try {\n            String body = readBody(exchange);\n            Map<String, Object> req = parseJsonObject(body);\n            int roll = toInt(req.get(\"roll\"));\n            int modifier = IOException {\n        if (!\"POST\".equals(exchange.getRequestMethod())) {\n            sendResponse(exchange, 405, \"{\\\"error\\\":\\\"Method not allowed\\\"}\");\n            return;\n        }\n        try {\n            String body = readBody(exchange);\n            Map<String, Object> req = parseJsonObject(body);\n            List<Object> partyList = (List<Object>) req.get(\"party\");\n            List<Object> monstersList = (List<Object>) req.get(\"monsters\");\n            if (partyList == null || monstersList == null) throw new RuntimeException(\"Missing fields\");\n\n            int baseXp = 0;\n            int monsterCount = 0;\n            for (Object monsterObj : monstersList) {\n                Map<String, Object> monster = (Map<String, Object>) monsterObj;\n                String cr = (String) monster.get(\"cr\");\n                int count = toInt(monster.get(\"count\"));\n                Integer xp = CR_XP.get(cr);\n                if (xp == null) throw new RuntimeException(\"Unsupported CR: \" + cr);\n                baseXp += xp * count;\n                monsterCount += count;\n            }\n\n            double multiplier;\n            if (monsterCount == 1) multiplier = 1;\n            else if (monsterCount == 2) multiplier = 1.5;\n            else if (monsterCount <= 6) multiplier = 2;\n            else if (monsterCount <= 10) multiplier = 2.5;\n            else if (monsterCount <= 14) multiplier = 3;\n            else multiplier = 4;\n\n            long adjustedXp = Math.round(baseXp * multiplier);\n\n            int easy = 0, medium = 0, hard = 0, deadly = 0;\n            for (Object memberObj : partyList) {\n                Map<String, Object> member = (Map<String, Object>) memberObj;\n                int level = toInt(member.get(\"level\"));\n                int[] thresholds = LEVEL_THRESHOLDS.get(level);\n                if (thresholds == null) throw new RuntimeException(\"Unsupported level: \" + level);\n                easy += thresholds[0];\n                medium += thresholds[1];\n                hard += thresholds[2];\n                deadly += thresholds[3];\n            }\n\n            String difficulty;\n            if (adjustedXp >= deadly) difficulty = \"deadly\";\n            else if (adjustedXp >= hard) difficulty = \"hard\";\n            else if (adjustedXp >= medium) difficulty = \"medium\";\n            else if (adjustedXp >= easy) difficulty = \"easy\";\n            else difficulty = \"trivial\";\n\n            Map<String, Object> thresholds = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n            thresholds.put(\"easy\", easy);\n            thresholds.put(\"medium\", medium);\n            thresholds.put(\"hard\", hard);\n            thresholds.put(\"deadly\", deadly);\n\n            Map<String, Object> res = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n            res.put(\"base_xp\", baseXp);\n            res.put(\"monster_count\", monsterCount);\n            res.put(\"multiplier\", multiplier);\n            res.put(\"adjusted_xp\", adjustedXp);\n            res.put(\"difficulty\", difficulty);\n            res.put(\"thresholds\", thresholds);\n            sendResponse(exchange, 200, toJson(res));\n        } catch (Exception e) {\n            sendResponse(exchange, 400, \"{\\\"error\\\":\\\"Invalid request\\\"}\");\n        }\n    }\n\n    private static void handleInitiative(HttpExchange exchange) throws IOException {\n        if (!\"POST\".equals(exchange.getRequestMethod())) {\n            sendResponse(exchange, 405, \"{\\\"error\\\":\\\"Method not sendResponse(exchange, 405, \"{\\\"error\\\":\\\"Method not allowed\\\"}\");\n            return;\n        }\n        try {\n            String body = readBody(exchange);\n            Map<String,      Matcher matcher = DICE_PATTERN.matcher(expression.trim());\n            if (!matcher.matches()) throw new RuntimeException(\"Invalid expression\");\n            int count = Integer.parseInt(matcher.group(1));\n            int sides = Integer.parseInt(matcher.group(2));\n            if (count <= 0 || sides <= 0) throw new RuntimeException(\"Count and sides must be            res.put(\"max\", count * sides + modifier);\n            res.put(\"average\", count * (sides + 1) / 2.0 + modifier);\n            sendResponse(exchange, 200, toJson(res));\n        } catch IOException {\n        if (!\"POST\".equals(exchange.getRequestMethod())) {\n            sendResponse(exchange, 405, \"{\\\"error\\\":\\\"Method not allowed\\\"}\");\n            return;\n        }\n        try {\n            String body = readBody(exchange);\n            Map<String, Object> req = parseJsonObject(body);\n            List<Object> partyList = (List<Object>) req.get(\"party\");\n            List<Object> monstersList = (List<Object>) req.get(\"monsters\");\n            if (partyList == null || monstersList == null) throw new RuntimeException(\"Missing fields\");\n\n            int baseXp = 0;\n            int monsterCount = 0;\n            for (Object monsterObj : monstersList) {\n                Map<String, Object> monster = (Map<String, Object>) monsterObj;\n                String cr = (String) monster.get(\"cr\");\n                int count = toInt(monster.get(\"count\"));\n                Integer xp = CR_XP.get(cr);\n                if (xp == null) throw new RuntimeException(\"Unsupported CR: \" + cr);\n                baseXp += xp * count;\n                monsterCount += count;\n            }\n\n            double multiplier;\n            if (monsterCount == 1) multiplier = 1;\n            else if (monsterCount == 2) multiplier = 1.5;\n            else if (monsterCount <= 6) multiplier = 2;\n            else if (monsterCount <= 10) multiplier = 2.5;\n            else if (monsterCount <= 14) multiplier = 3;\n            else multiplier = 4;\n\n            long adjustedXp = Math.round(baseXp * multiplier);\n\n            int easy = 0, medium = 0, hard = 0, deadly = 0;\n            for (Object memberObj : partyList) {\n                Map<String, Object> member = (Map<String, Object>) memberObj;\n                int level = toInt(member.get(\"level\"));\n                int[] thresholds = LEVEL_THRESHOLDS.get(level);\n                if (thresholds == null) throw new RuntimeException(\"Unsupported level: \" + level);\n                easy += thresholds[0];\n                medium += thresholds[1];\n                hard += thresholds[2];\n                deadly += thresholds[3];\n            }\n\n            String difficulty;\n            if (adjustedXp >= deadly) difficulty = \"deadly\";\n            else if (adjustedXp >= hard) difficulty = \"hard\";\n            else if (adjustedXp >= medium) difficulty = \"medium\";\n            else if (adjustedXp >= easy) difficulty = \"easy\";\n            else difficulty = \"trivial\";\n\n            Map<String, Object> thresholds = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n            thresholds.put(\"easy\", easy);\n            thresholds.put(\"medium\", medium);\n            thresholds.put(\"hard\", hard);\n            thresholds.put(\"deadly\", deadly);\n\n            Map<String, Object> res = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n            res.put(\"base_xp\", baseXp);\n            res.put(\"monster_count\", monsterCount);\n            res.put(\"multiplier\", multiplier);\n            res.put(\"adjusted_xp\", adjustedXp);\n            res.put(\"difficulty\", difficulty);\n            res.put(\"thresholds\", thresholds);\n            sendResponse(exchange, 200, toJson(res));\n        } catch (Exception e) {\n            sendResponse(exchange, 400, \"{\\\"error\\\":\\\"Invalid request\\\"}\");\n        }\n    }\n\n    private static void static void handleCombatSessionAction(HttpExchange exchange) throws IOException {\n        if (!\"POST\".equals(exchange.getRequestMethod())) {\n            sendResponse(exchange, 405, return;\n        }\n        String id = rest.substring(0, slash);\n        String action = rest.substring(slash + 1);\n        CombatSession session = STORAGE.getCombatSession(id);\n        if       res.put(\"conditions\", conditions);\n                sendResponse(exchange, 200, toJson(res));\n            } else if (\"advance\".equals(action)) {\n                session.turnIndex++;\n                if (session.turnIndex >= session.order.size()) {\n                    session.turnIndex = 0;\n                    session.round++;\n                }\n                Combatant active =     res.put(\"active\", combatantJson(active));\n                Map<String, Object> conditions = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n                for (Map.Entry<String, List<Condition>> entry : IOException {\n        if (!\"POST\".equals(exchange.getRequestMethod())) {\n            sendResponse(exchange, 405, \"{\\\"error\\\":\\\"Method not allowed\\\"}\");\n            return;\n        }\n        try {\n            String body = readBody(exchange);\n            Map<String, Object> req = parseJsonObject(body);\n            List<Object> partyList = (List<Object>) req.get(\"party\");\n            List<Object> monstersList = (List<Object>) req.get(\"monsters\");\n            if (partyList == null || monstersList == null) throw new RuntimeException(\"Missing fields\");\n\n            int baseXp = 0;\n            int monsterCount = 0;\n            for (Object monsterObj : monstersList) {\n                Map<String, Object> monster = (Map<String, Object>) monsterObj;\n                String cr = (String) monster.get(\"cr\");\n                int count = toInt(monster.get(\"count\"));\n                Integer xp = CR_XP.get(cr);\n                if (xp == null) throw new RuntimeException(\"Unsupported CR: \" + cr);\n                baseXp += xp * count;\n                monsterCount += count;\n            }\n\n            double multiplier;\n            if (monsterCount == 1) multiplier = 1;\n            else if (monsterCount == 2) multiplier = 1.5;\n            else if (monsterCount <= 6) multiplier = 2;\n            else if (monsterCount <= 10) multiplier = 2.5;\n            else if (monsterCount <= 14) multiplier = 3;\n            else multiplier = 4;\n\n            long adjustedXp = Math.round(baseXp * multiplier);\n\n            int easy = 0, medium = 0, hard = 0, deadly = 0;\n            for (Object memberObj : partyList) {\n                Map<String, Object> member = (Map<String, Object>) memberObj;\n                int level = toInt(member.get(\"level\"));\n                int[] thresholds = LEVEL_THRESHOLDS.get(level);\n                if (thresholds == null) throw new RuntimeException(\"Unsupported level: \" + level);\n                easy += thresholds[0];\n                medium += thresholds[1];\n                hard += thresholds[2];\n                deadly += thresholds[3];\n            }\n\n            String difficulty;\n            if (adjustedXp >= deadly) difficulty = \"deadly\";\n            else if (adjustedXp >= hard) difficulty = \"hard\";\n            else if (adjustedXp >= medium) difficulty = \"medium\";\n            else if (adjustedXp >= easy) difficulty = \"easy\";\n            else difficulty = \"trivial\";\n\n            Map<String, Object> thresholds = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n            thresholds.put(\"easy\", easy);\n            thresholds.put(\"medium\", medium);\n            thresholds.put(\"hard\", hard);\n            thresholds.put(\"deadly\", deadly);\n\n            Map<String, Object> res = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n            res.put(\"base_xp\", baseXp);\n            res.put(\"monster_count\", monsterCount);\n            res.put(\"multiplier\", multiplier);\n            res.put(\"adjusted_xp\", adjustedXp);\n            res.put(\"difficulty\", difficulty);\n            res.put(\"thresholds\", thresholds);\n            sendResponse(exchange, 200, toJson(res));\n        } catch (Exception e) {\n            sendResponse(exchange, 400, \"{\\\"error\\\":\\\"Invalid request\\\"}\");\n        }\n    }\n\n    private static void handleInitiative(HttpExchange exchange) throws IOException {\n        if (!\"POST\".equals(exchange.getRequestMethod())) {\n            sendResponse(exchange, 405, \"{\\\"error\\\":\\\"Method not static void handleCombatSessionAction(HttpExchange exchange) throws IOException {\n        if (!\"POST\".equals(exchange.getRequestMethod())) {\n            sendResponse(exchange, 405, IOException {\n        if (!\"POST\".equals(exchange.getRequestMethod())) {\n            sendResponse(exchange, 405, \"{\\\"error\\\":\\\"Method not allowed\\\"}\");\n            return;\n        }\n        try {\n            String body = readBody(exchange);\n            Map<String, Object> req = parseJsonObject(body);\n            List<Object> partyList = (List<Object>) req.get(\"party\");\n            List<Object> monstersList = (List<Object>) req.get(\"monsters\");\n            if (partyList == null || monstersList == null) throw new RuntimeException(\"Missing fields\");\n\n            int baseXp = 0;\n            int monsterCount = 0;\n            for (Object monsterObj : monstersList) {\n                Map<String, Object> monster = (Map<String, Object>) monsterObj;\n                String cr = (String) monster.get(\"cr\");\n                int count = toInt(monster.get(\"count\"));\n                Integer xp = CR_XP.get(cr);\n                if (xp == null) throw new RuntimeException(\"Unsupported CR: \" + cr);\n                baseXp += xp * count;\n                monsterCount += count;\n            }\n\n            double multiplier;\n            if (monsterCount == 1) multiplier = 1;\n            else if (monsterCount == 2) multiplier = 1.5;\n            else if (monsterCount <= 6) multiplier = 2;\n            else if (monsterCount <= 10) multiplier = 2.5;\n            else if (monsterCount <= 14) multiplier = 3;\n            else multiplier = 4;\n\n            long adjustedXp = Math.round(baseXp * multiplier);\n\n            int easy = 0, medium = 0, hard = 0, deadly = 0;\n            for (Object memberObj : partyList) {\n                Map<String, Object> member = (Map<String, Object>) memberObj;\n                int level = toInt(member.get(\"level\"));\n                int[] thresholds = LEVEL_THRESHOLDS.get(level);\n                if (thresholds == null) throw new RuntimeException(\"Unsupported level: \" + level);\n                easy += thresholds[0];\n                medium += thresholds[1];\n                hard += thresholds[2];\n                deadly += thresholds[3];\n            }\n\n            String difficulty;\n            if (adjustedXp >= deadly) difficulty = \"deadly\";\n            else if (adjustedXp >= hard) difficulty = \"hard\";\n            else if (adjustedXp >= medium) difficulty = \"medium\";\n            else if (adjustedXp >= easy) difficulty = \"easy\";\n            else difficulty = \"trivial\";\n\n            Map<String, Object> thresholds = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n            thresholds.put(\"easy\", easy);\n            thresholds.put(\"medium\", medium);\n            thresholds.put(\"hard\", hard);\n            thresholds.put(\"deadly\", deadly);\n\n            Map<String, Object> res = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n            res.put(\"base_xp\", baseXp);\n            res.put(\"monster_count\", monsterCount);\n            res.put(\"multiplier\", multiplier);\n            res.put(\"adjusted_xp\", adjustedXp);\n            res.put(\"difficulty\", difficulty);\n            res.put(\"thresholds\", thresholds);\n            sendResponse(exchange, 200, toJson(res));\n        } catch (Exception e) {\n            sendResponse(exchange, 400, \"{\\\"error\\\":\\\"Invalid request\\\"}\");\n        }\n    }\n\n    private static void handleInitiative(HttpExchange exchange) throws IOException {\n        if (!\"POST\".equals(exchange.getRequestMethod())) {\n            sendResponse(exchange, 405, \"{\\\"error\\\":\\\"Method not               combatants.add(out);\n            }\n\n            combatants.sort((a, b) -> {\n                int scoreA = (Integer) a.get(\"score\");\n                int scoreB = (Integer) static void handleCombatSessionAction(HttpExchange exchange) throws IOException {\n        if (!\"POST\".equals(exchange.getRequestMethod())) {\n            sendResponse(exchange, 405, IOException {\n        if (!\"POST\".equals(exchange.getRequestMethod())) {\n            sendResponse(exchange, 405, \"{\\\"error\\\":\\\"Method not allowed\\\"}\");\n            return;\n        }\n        try {\n            String body = readBody(exchange);\n            Map<String, Object> req = parseJsonObject(body);\n            List<Object> partyList = (List<Object>) req.get(\"party\");\n            List<Object> monstersList = (List<Object>) req.get(\"monsters\");\n            if (partyList == null || monstersList == null) throw new RuntimeException(\"Missing fields\");\n\n            int baseXp = 0;\n            int monsterCount = 0;\n            for (Object monsterObj : monstersList) {\n                Map<String, Object> monster = (Map<String, Object>) monsterObj;\n                String cr = (String) monster.get(\"cr\");\n                int count = toInt(monster.get(\"count\"));\n                Integer xp = CR_XP.get(cr);\n                if (xp == null) throw new RuntimeException(\"Unsupported CR: \" + cr);\n                baseXp += xp * count;\n                monsterCount += count;\n            }\n\n            double multiplier;\n            if (monsterCount == 1) multiplier = 1;\n            else if (monsterCount == 2) multiplier = 1.5;\n            else if (monsterCount <= 6) multiplier = 2;\n            else if (monsterCount <= 10) multiplier = 2.5;\n            else if (monsterCount <= 14) multiplier = 3;\n            else multiplier = 4;\n\n            long adjustedXp = Math.round(baseXp * multiplier);\n\n            int easy = 0, medium = 0, hard = 0, deadly = 0;\n            for (Object memberObj : partyList) {\n                Map<String, Object> member = (Map<String, Object>) memberObj;\n                int level = toInt(member.get(\"level\"));\n                int[] thresholds = LEVEL_THRESHOLDS.get(level);\n                if (thresholds == null) throw new RuntimeException(\"Unsupported level: \" + level);\n                easy += thresholds[0];\n                medium += thresholds[1];\n                hard += thresholds[2];\n                deadly += thresholds[3];\n            }\n\n            String difficulty;\n            if (adjustedXp >= deadly) difficulty = \"deadly\";\n            else if (adjustedXp >= hard) difficulty = \"hard\";\n            else if (adjustedXp >= medium) difficulty = \"medium\";\n            else if (adjustedXp >= easy) difficulty = \"easy\";\n            else difficulty = \"trivial\";\n\n            Map<String, Object> thresholds = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n            thresholds.put(\"easy\", easy);\n            thresholds.put(\"medium\", medium);\n            thresholds.put(\"hard\", hard);\n            thresholds.put(\"deadly\", deadly);\n\n            Map<String, Object> res = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n            res.put(\"base_xp\", baseXp);\n            res.put(\"monster_count\", monsterCount);\n            res.put(\"multiplier\", multiplier);\n            res.put(\"adjusted_xp\", adjustedXp);\n            res.put(\"difficulty\", difficulty);\n            res.put(\"thresholds\", thresholds);\n            sendResponse(exchange, 200, toJson(res));\n        } catch (Exception e) {\n            sendResponse(exchange, 400, \"{\\\"error\\\":\\\"Invalid request\\\"}\");\n        }\n    }\n\n    private static void handleInitiative(HttpExchange exchange) throws IOException {\n        if (!\"POST\".equals(exchange.getRequestMethod())) {\n            sendResponse(exchange, 405, \"{\\\"error\\\":\\\"Method not      Matcher matcher = DICE_PATTERN.matcher(expression.trim());\n            if (!matcher.matches()) throw new RuntimeException(\"Invalid expression\");\n            int count = Integer.parseInt(matcher.group(1));\n            int sides = Integer.parseInt(matcher.group(2));\n            if (count <= 0 || sides <= 0) throw new RuntimeException(\"Count and sides must be positive\");\n            String modifierPart = matcher.group(3);\n            int modifier = modifierPart == null ? 0 : Integer.parseInt(modifierPart);\n\n            Map<String, Object> res = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n            res.put(\"dice_count\", count);\n            res.put(\"sides\", sides);\n            res.put(\"modifier\", modifier);\n            res.put(\"min\", count + modifier);\n            res.put(\"max\", count * sides + modifier);\n            res.put(\"average\", count * (sides + 1) / 2.0 + modifier);\n            sendResponse(exchange, 200, toJson(res));\n        } catch (Exception e) {\n            sendResponse(exchange, 400, \"{\\\"error\\\":\\\"Invalid request\\\"}\");\n        }\n    }\n\n    private static void handleAbilityCheck(HttpExchange exchange) throws IOException {\n        if (!\"POST\".equals(exchange.getRequestMethod())) {\n            sendResponse(exchange, 405, \"{\\\"error\\\":\\\"Method not allowed\\\"}\");\n            return;\n        }\n        try {\n            String body = readBody(exchange);\n            Map<String, Object> req = parseJsonObject(body);\n            int roll = toInt(req.get(\"roll\"));\n            int modifier = res.put(\"total\", total);\n            res.put(\"success\", total >= dc);\n            res.put(\"margin\", total - dc);\n            sendResponse(exchange, 200, toJson(res));\n        } catch IOException {\n        if (!\"POST\".equals(exchange.getRequestMethod())) {\n            sendResponse(exchange, 405, \"{\\\"error\\\":\\\"Method not allowed\\\"}\");\n            return;\n        }\n        try {\n            String body = readBody(exchange);\n            Map<String, Object> req = parseJsonObject(body);\n            List<Object> partyList = (List<Object>) req.get(\"party\");\n            List<Object> monstersList = (List<Object>) req.get(\"monsters\");\n            if (partyList == null || monstersList == null) throw new RuntimeException(\"Missing fields\");\n\n            int baseXp = 0;\n            int monsterCount = 0;\n            for (Object monsterObj : monstersList) {\n                Map<String, Object> monster = (Map<String, Object>) monsterObj;\n                String cr = (String) monster.get(\"cr\");\n                int count = toInt(monster.get(\"count\"));\n                Integer xp = CR_XP.get(cr);\n                if (xp == null) throw new RuntimeException(\"Unsupported CR: \" + cr);\n                baseXp += xp * count;\n                monsterCount += count;\n            }\n\n            double multiplier;\n            if (monsterCount == 1) multiplier = 1;\n            else if (monsterCount == 2) multiplier = 1.5;\n            else if (monsterCount <= 6) multiplier = 2;\n            else if (monsterCount <= 10) multiplier = 2.5;\n            else if (monsterCount <= 14) multiplier = 3;\n            else multiplier = 4;\n\n            long adjustedXp = Math.round(baseXp * multiplier);\n\n            int easy = 0, medium = 0, hard = 0, deadly = 0;\n            for (Object memberObj : partyList) {\n                Map<String, Object> member = (Map<String, Object>) memberObj;\n                int level = toInt(member.get(\"level\"));\n                int[] thresholds = LEVEL_THRESHOLDS.get(level);\n                if (thresholds == null) throw new RuntimeException(\"Unsupported level: \" + level);\n                easy += thresholds[0];\n                medium += thresholds[1];\n                hard += thresholds[2];\n                deadly += thresholds[3];\n            }\n\n            String difficulty;\n            if (adjustedXp >= deadly) difficulty = \"deadly\";\n            else if (adjustedXp >= hard) difficulty = \"hard\";\n            else if (adjustedXp >= medium) difficulty = \"medium\";\n            else if (adjustedXp >= easy) difficulty = \"easy\";\n            else difficulty = \"trivial\";\n\n            Map<String, Object> thresholds = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n            thresholds.put(\"easy\", easy);\n            thresholds.put(\"medium\", medium);\n            thresholds.put(\"hard\", hard);\n            thresholds.put(\"deadly\", deadly);\n\n            Map<String, Object> res = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n            res.put(\"base_xp\", baseXp);\n            res.put(\"monster_count\", monsterCount);\n            res.put(\"multiplier\", multiplier);\n            res.put(\"adjusted_xp\", adjustedXp);\n            res.put(\"difficulty\", difficulty);\n            res.put(\"thresholds\", thresholds);\n            sendResponse(exchange, 200, toJson(res));\n        } catch (Exception e) {\n            sendResponse(exchange, 400, \"{\\\"error\\\":\\\"Invalid request\\\"}\");\n        }\n    }\n\n    private static void handleInitiative(HttpExchange exchange) throws IOException {\n        if (!\"POST\".equals(exchange.getRequestMethod())) {\n            sendResponse(exchange, 405, \"{\\\"error\\\":\\\"Method not dex;\n                Map<String, Object> out = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n                out.put(\"name\", name);\n                out.put(\"score\", score);\n                out.put(\"_dex\", dex);\n                combatants.add(out);\n            }\n\n            combatants.sort((a, b) -> {\n                int scoreA = (Integer) a.get(\"score\");\n                int scoreB = (Integer)        if (dexB != dexA) return dexB - dexA;\n                String nameA = (String) a.get(\"name\");\n                String nameB = (String) b.get(\"name\");\n                return
